Linear Regression 
 
Section A 
Answer the following questions [1 mark] 
 
1. How many samples are there? 
From csv file we get no. of samples = 414

 X3 distance to the nearest MRT station 
 X4 number of convenience stores 
 X5 latitude 
 X6 longitude
